    • printPickupCargoOptions

      public static void printPickupCargoOptions()
      Displays the available cargo types for pickup, allowing users to select them by entering corresponding numbers. The cargo types are displayed with their indexes in the format: [index] CargoTypeName. The options shown include people, mail, coal, and iron, but exclude steel. Each cargo type is represented by its display name.

    • fromPickupMenuOptions

      public static List<CargoTypes> fromPickupMenuOptions(String input)
      Parses a space-separated string of numeric selections and maps them to corresponding cargo types. The numeric input values correspond to predefined cargo type indices, starting from 1. Invalid or out-of-range selections are ignored, and duplicate selections are filtered out. An exception is thrown if no valid cargo types are selected.
      Parameters:
      input - a space-separated string representing numeric selections of cargo types
      Returns:
      a list of CargoTypes corresponding to the valid selections from the input
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no valid cargo selections are provided
